dogecoin.text:
Elon Musk confirmed his personal holdings during a panel today:

- Tesla
- SpaceX
- Bitcoin
- Ethereum
- Dogecoin

Robinhood (and other brokers) down 7% on a Gensler (SEC chairman) interview remark that a Payment for order flow ban is on the table.

The rise of crypto + dogecoin is a big benefit for RH since now under 40% of their revenue is PFOF as traditionally defined
